info.name: NexRead API - Mentor Requirements Test Suite
info.description:
Smoke Test + Regression Test collection for the NexRead API, structured to cover the 9 mentor requirements:
1. Test all API endpoints
2. Request validation
3. CRUD endpoints for core resources
4. Use Postman/Newman for automated testing (this collection itself)
5. JWT-based authentication (login/register)
6. Route protection middleware (JwtAuthGuard)
7. Error handling
8. Data integrity & constraints/relationships
9. Integration testing with seeded data

Run with the 'Local' environment against a running dev server (npm run start:dev).
